exposure: Prophylactic internal iliac artery balloon occlusion (IIABO)
cohort: The study included 616 confirmed patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), specifically placenta accreta, increta, and percreta, who were managed between December 2013 and December 2022.
finding: Prophylactic IIABO significantly reduced intraoperative bleeding and operation duration in placenta percreta patients but was associated with greater hospitalization costs and a trend towards increased vascular complications.
